hook: My coffee maker left the counter for $34.97

scenes.visual_prompt: Coffee maker and blender crowding a small kitchen counter
scenes.voiceover: I tried a $28 appliance tray first. The toaster was back on the counter in a week.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a cluttered lower cabinet with pots jammed in
scenes.on_screen_text: The cabinet wasn't the problem - the access was
scenes.voiceover: The real issue wasn't space in the cabinet. It was that nothing in it was easy to reach.

scenes.visual_prompt: Installing the Simple Houseware 2-Tier Sliding Basket Organizer under the counter
scenes.voiceover: This chrome sliding basket organizer is $34.97 and turns dead cabinet space into pull-out access.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand sliding the basket out smoothly to grab the coffee grinder
scenes.on_screen_text: As fast as the counter now
scenes.voiceover: Pulling the grinder out now takes the same two seconds as leaving it on the counter.

scenes.visual_prompt: Coffee maker and grinder stored inside the cabinet, basket pulled halfway out
scenes.voiceover: A week later, it still hasn't migrated back.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of a clear counter next to an open cabinet showing organized baskets
scenes.voiceover: The counter's clear, and the cabinet still closes.

caption: I was skeptical an appliance 'garage' would actually work - the $28 tray version didn't. What worked was giving the coffee maker a spot in the cabinet that's genuinely as fast to reach as the counter. The Simple Houseware 2-Tier Sliding Basket Organizer is $34.97. Full comparison on the blog.
